_comment: The single registry of AI/ML capabilities Lumon is structured for. status: READY (model + data deployed and validated for the pilot), STAGED (model weights present locally, not yet validated), PARTIAL (a non-ML fallback runs, the learned model does not), NOT STAGED (designed, nothing deployed). Nothing here produces output until a real model is staged; the 'fallback' field names the existing deterministic component, if any, that runs today on the demo AOI. A capability with a 'runtime' block (semantic-search) has its status set at runtime from the model files actually present, plus a separate retrieval_status (NOT STAGED / INDEXING / READY / PARTIAL / UNAVAILABLE) describing its index.

capabilities.name: Semantic Satellite Search
capabilities.purpose: Rank staged Sentinel-2 image chips by how similar their RemoteCLIP embedding is to a text description (e.g. 'airport runway').
requires_data: Staged Sentinel-2 L2A scenes (demo AOI today)
capabilities.component: RemoteCLIP image/text embeddings + cosine-similarity ranking over cached chip embeddings (exact search, no approximate index needed at this size)
capabilities.vector_index: SQLite embedding cache, exact cosine search
capabilities.output: Ranked image chips: scene id, acquisition date, chip footprint, cosine similarity (not a probability), provenance
capabilities.limitations: Model similarity only: a high rank is NOT a detection and does not prove an object is present. RemoteCLIP was trained mostly on sub-metre to few-metre imagery; Sentinel-2 is 10 m, so small objects are invisible and ranking is coarse. Covers the staged demo AOI only; no NIT Raipur imagery is staged, so pilot-scoped image search returns nothing. Not validated against ground truth.

capabilities.name: Image-to-Image Similarity
capabilities.purpose: Find image chips that look like a chosen example chip: look-alike places elsewhere, or how much each date at the same place looks like it.
requires_data: Staged Sentinel-2 L2A scenes (demo AOI today)
embedding cache (semantic_chips table, shared with semantic search)
capabilities.component: Cosine similarity between cached RemoteCLIP image embeddings (exact search); no model inference at query time
capabilities.output: Ranked image chips: scene id, acquisition date, chip footprint, cosine similarity (not a probability), provenance
capabilities.fallback: Separate non-ML tool, still available and labelled 'non-semantic': spectral / change-history feature similarity of 100 m tiles (FIND TILES LIKE THIS, Dossiers). It is never used in place of the model.
capabilities.limitations: Visual similarity of 10 m true-colour chips only: looking alike is not evidence of the same objects or activity. Compares chips of the same size only. Demo AOI only (one small area, so few distinct places at 2.24 km); no NIT Raipur imagery is staged. Not validated against ground truth.

capabilities.name: Discovery & Embedding Clustering
capabilities.purpose: Group the whole image archive by RemoteCLIP embedding similarity so the analyst can start from one interesting chip and explore every other place in its group (PS 26227 §2.2.4), without writing a new query.
capabilities.component: Spherical k-means per chip size on the cached embeddings (numpy; k by silhouette; deterministic seeds); versioned clusters; incremental assignment of new chips to frozen centroids
capabilities.output: Versioned clusters with neutral IDs, members (AOI, scene, date, footprint, embedding version), representatives, places, extent, compactness, provenance; reference chip -> cluster -> places ranked by similarity
capabilities.limitations: Embedding-based groupings, not semantic classes: no cluster is named after an object or activity. Weak cluster structure on this archive (silhouette 0.19-0.22); some clusters are driven by haze, season or a single dominant place. One small AOI (34 places). Incremental updates assign new chips to existing clusters only; new kinds of imagery need a re-cluster (new version).

capabilities.name: EO Embedding / Representation Search
capabilities.purpose: Turn each image tile into a learned vector for search, clustering and similarity.
capabilities.limitations: Model weights, compute and a vector store are not staged.

capabilities.name: Building / Object Segmentation
capabilities.purpose: Outline buildings and objects in imagery.
capabilities.output: Polygons with model, version and confidence
capabilities.limitations: 10 m Sentinel-2 is too coarse for individual buildings; needs sub-metre imagery and footprints for validation.

capabilities.name: Learned Change Detection
capabilities.purpose: Mark MODEL-GENERATED CANDIDATE CHANGES between two dated Sentinel-2 scenes of the same place, for analyst review.
requires_data: Two usable Sentinel-2 L2A scenes on the same pixel grid (demo AOI today)
capabilities.component: BTC-B bi-temporal network on 96 px tiles (overlap-averaged) + rule-based pair checks and evidence flags
capabilities.output: Georeferenced score and candidate-mask GeoTIFFs, candidate regions with scores, spectral context, flags, persistence, baseline overlap, provenance and analyst review
capabilities.fallback: Separate rule-based baseline, still available and labelled: composite change engine with six false-alarm gates (Change Detection / Change Explorer). Never used in place of the model.
capabilities.limitations: Candidates, not verified change. Trained on OSCD (urban changes, L1C top-of-atmosphere 2015-2018); Lumon's archive is L2A, so colours differ (blue darker). Large homogeneous changes (levelled ground, runways) are often missed; tidal/seasonal water and vegetation produce false alarms across seasons. Checkpoint licence unstated, trained on CC BY-NC-SA data: non-commercial research only. Demo AOI only; no NIT Raipur imagery.

capabilities.name: Land-Cover Classification
capabilities.purpose: Label each area as built, vegetation, water, bare and similar classes.
capabilities.fallback: Spectral-index thresholds (implemented, demo AOI only, uncalibrated)
capabilities.limitations: Needs labelled reference data to train and validate.

capabilities.name: Construction Detection
capabilities.purpose: Find new buildings and earthworks and date them.
capabilities.component: Change model specialised to construction + footprint linking
capabilities.fallback: Heuristic soil-to-built rule in the change engine (demo AOI only, unvalidated)
capabilities.limitations: Building-level answers need footprints and sub-metre imagery.

capabilities.name: Vegetation Analysis
capabilities.purpose: Measure vegetation cover and its change over seasons and years.
capabilities.component: Index time series (NDVI) with seasonal composites
capabilities.fallback: NDVI-based vegetation class inside the change engine (demo AOI only)
capabilities.limitations: No imagery staged for the pilot area.

capabilities.name: Temporal Pattern Analysis
capabilities.purpose: Describe how a place changes over time (phases, seasonality, persistence).
capabilities.fallback: Per-tile observation history (implemented, demo AOI only)

capabilities.name: Evidence-Grounded Analyst Summary
capabilities.purpose: Summarise findings strictly from stored evidence, with references and confidence.
capabilities.component: Local language model constrained to cited evidence
capabilities.output: Short summary with evidence references; never unsupported claims
capabilities.fallback: Evidence cards, gates and provenance are already shown for every change (no generated text)
capabilities.limitations: No local language model is staged; nothing is generated.
